seo.metaDescription: Add AI-powered email marketing to your digital portfolio. Hostopia's white-label platform drives SMB engagement and recurring revenue for partners.

hero.headline: White-Label Email Marketing That Drives Revenue
hero.description: Your SMB customers need email marketing — the only question is whether they get it from you or from a disconnected tool with no link to your brand. Hostopia puts an AI-powered campaign platform in their hands under your logo, turning a proven marketing channel into a recurring revenue stream you own end to end.

features.heading: Everything Your SMBs Need — Under Your Brand
features.intro: Hostopia handles the technology, the deliverability, and the compliance infrastructure. You own the customer experience, the pricing, and the recurring revenue.

cards.title: AI-Powered Campaign Builder
cards.body: Customers create professional emails in minutes using AI-generated copy, images, and layouts tailored to their business type. No design skills required.

cards.title: Smart Segmentation & Automation
cards.body: Automated workflows and audience segmentation deliver the right message at the right time — welcome sequences, promotions, and re-engagement flows included.

cards.title: Drag-and-Drop Editor
cards.body: Mobile-responsive templates plus custom HTML support. Simplicity for beginners, full creative control for advanced users — same platform, same experience.

cards.title: Contact & List Management
cards.body: Built-in subscriber forms and list management connect directly to the SMB's website, turning visitors into contacts automatically and building the list passively.

cards.title: Performance Analytics
cards.body: Opens, clicks, conversions, and audience insights — giving SMBs visibility into what works and your team data to drive meaningful upsell conversations.

cards.title: Flexible Packaging
cards.body: Sell standalone or bundled with hosting and website design. You set the plans, tiers, and pricing that match your market strategy.

partnerAdvantage.heading: Built for Service Providers. Not Bolted On.
partnerAdvantage.intro: Email marketing that integrates into your ecosystem — not another disconnected SaaS tool your customers juggle alongside everything else you sell.

items.title: Cross-sell into your base
items.body: Every website and hosting customer is an email marketing prospect. Bundling drives higher attachment rates, increases ARPU, and reduces churn across your portfolio.

items.title: Launch without complexity
items.body: Automated provisioning through Hostopia's platform. No infrastructure to build, no campaign management team to staff, no onboarding bottlenecks to operate.

items.title: Scale revenue, not headcount
items.body: AI handles the heavy lifting for your SMB customers. Automation handles it for your operations team. You grow revenue without growing cost.

items.title: Recapture spend already leaving your ecosystem
items.body: Every SMB currently using a standalone email tool is spending money on a platform that's not yours. Email marketing recovers that wallet share and brings it back under your brand.

lifecycleFit.heading: Email Naturally Fits Your Digital Services Stack
lifecycleFit.intro: When you deliver email marketing through Hostopia, you capture a service your customers are already paying for elsewhere — or missing entirely.
